---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
top_sluggers <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
    active_steroid_era = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  top_sluggers,
  aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = active_steroid_era
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Active during\nsteroid era",
    values = c("No" = "#767676", "Yes" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Runs: Top 15 Sluggers",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database. Active means a career overlapped 1994-2009."
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    season_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = season_home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
